factory.purpose: Verify that a real caller reaches the first correct authorized result through the declared agent surface.
factory.beneficiary: Developers and digital workers using Tedix gateways and browser tools
exclusions: No permission escalation to make a test pass
No production fixture mutation without exact approval

intake.sourcePolicy: Versioned scenario identifiers, contract revisions, deployed SHA and sanitized receipts; no credentials.

templates.title: Certify agent-surface scenario
templates.procedure: Bind this instance to exactly one program and surface: Gateway UX or WebMCP. Use held-out scenarios and isolated permitted fixtures. Record discovery, exact callable schema, authorization, cancellation, canonical result and partial failures. Measure tokens and turns to first correct call. A source test is not browser-host or deployed proof; record surface and deployed SHA. Never combine the two programs' ownership or expand scopes to pass.

acceptanceContract.doneLooksLike: A source-grounded proposal/report satisfies the instance's bounded scenario. No publication or business outcome is implied.

templates.title: Review no-work finding
templates.procedure: Record the exact inputs and scan coverage, exclusions, duplicates, and why no deliverable is warranted. Missing sources, authorization failures, or truncated discovery are blocked/partial, never no-work. Do not advance accepted/published cursors from scan success alone.

acceptanceContract.doneLooksLike: The settlement records complete bounded source coverage and a justified no-work result, not a hidden failure.

maintenance.successMetric: Scenario pass rate and tokens/turns to first correct call, separated by surface and revision.
